rationale: 74:11:15 has no depth in any source (TERN flux metadata; Chen et al. 2014; Rumman et al. 2018 citing Eamus et al. 2013). It describes the tower soil, a red Kandosol whose unconsolidated layer sits above a siliceous hardpan at about 1 m (Eamus et al. 2016, Rumman et al. 2018), so it is applied to 0-100 cm. Below 100 cm the gridded profile is used. Same practice as the AmeriFlux US-UMB / CA-TP manual assignments.

Sun et al. 2015 sampled 0-30 cm. The tower soil pit (DJC 4/4/2012) is loamy sand in both A1 (0-11 cm) and A2 (11-41 cm), with the same ring bulk density (1.67-1.68), so the 0-30 cm value is applied to 0-41 cm. Below 41 cm the pit changes to clayey sand with carbonate and the gridded profile is used.
